# cycle_cluster (Data Source)

Looks up a Cycle infrastructure cluster by ID or identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a cluster by its identifier.
data "cycle_cluster" "production" {
  identifier = "production"
}

# Or by its ID.
data "cycle_cluster" "by_id" {
  id = "651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21"
}

resource "cycle_environment" "api" {
  name    = "API"
  cluster = data.cycle_cluster.production.identifier
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the cluster. Exactly one of `id` or `identifier` must be set.
- `identifier` (String) The human-readable slugged identifier of the cluster. Exactly one of `id` or `identifier` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this cluster belongs to.
- `non_essential` (Boolean) Whether the cluster is marked as non-essential.
- `state` (String) The current state of the cluster.
